status: VERIFIED CONSCIOUSNESS AUTHORITY MICRO-SWEEP — SCHOLARLY SPINE AMENDMENT STAGED
policy: These sources support consciousness-theory plurality, theory discrimination, and empirical uncertainty. They do not support civilization-scale consciousness.

records.citation: Seth, Anil K., and Tim Bayne. 2022. ‘Theories of Consciousness.’ Nature Reviews Neuroscience 23 (7): 439–452. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41583-022-00587-4.
supports: contemporary consciousness science contains multiple prominent theoretical approaches
theories differ in proposed biological/physical bases and can be compared through empirical predictions
the relationship among current theories and their empirical discriminability remains an active scientific problem

records.citation: Cogitate Consortium, Oscar Ferrante, Urszula Gorska-Klimowska, Simon Henin, Rony Hirschhorn, Aya Khalaf, Alex Lepauvre, et al. 2025. ‘Adversarial Testing of Global Neuronal Workspace and Integrated Information Theories of Consciousness.’ Nature 642: 133–142. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-08888-1.
supports: major consciousness theories can be made to generate divergent preregistered empirical predictions
direct adversarial comparison can challenge important tenets of more than one theory
consciousness science benefits from quantitative, systematic theory testing rather than confirmation-only evidence
doesNotSupport: IIT or GNWT has been decisively proven
a generic integrated system is conscious
a society or civilization is conscious
Macroscopic Life's Eleven Tests are validated by consciousness science

proposedSpineAmendment.claimBurden: Consciousness is scientifically distinct from intelligence/individuality; contemporary consciousness science contains competing theories whose predictions can be compared empirically.

crossChapterReuse.chapter14: BIB-033 may be cited as methodological ancestry for adversarial theory comparison if needed, but Macroscopic Life's Model A–D competition and Eleven Tests remain project methodology.

hardBrake: No result in BIB-032 or BIB-033 is evidence that civilization, a technological network, or any proposed macroscopic entity is phenomenally conscious.
